newsitem.title: USA: Childrens Broadcasting takes stake in Harmony.
newsitem.headline: Childrens Broadcasting takes stake in Harmony.

text.p: Childrens Broadcasting Corp (CBC) and Harmony Holdings Inc said Friday CBC acquired a 16.4 percent stake in Harmony, consisting of 600,000 shares and certain stock options.

The shares and options were acquired from Harvey Bibicoff, Harmony's chief executive. In addition to paying cash for the stake, CBC issued 60,000 shares of its common stock to Bibicoff, the companies said.
Upon completion of the deal, Christopher Dahl, CBC's president and chief executive, was named chairman of Harmony. Bibicoff remains as chief executive.
In addition, the Harmony's board of directors resigned and Dahl, William Cameron, Richard Perkins and William Toles were appointed as directors.

"This investment represents not only diversification for CBC, but also a tremendous opportunity for CBC to continue to grow Harmony's already significant piece of the more than $2 billion commercial production market and to assist in their newer areas of operation," Dahl said.
CBC's Aahs World Radio is a live, 24-hour radio network for children and families. Harmony produces television commercials, music videos, and World Wide Web sites.
